evaluation.reason: The calibrated query ran with enforced issues-first PRIMARY access, a leading-wildcard LOWER(subject) LIKE filter, and ORDER BY issues.id DESC LIMIT 10. Median latency was ~229 ms (>=200 ms threshold), indicating the slow behavior. The mechanism is present by design: the non-sargable LIKE prevents any subject index use, forcing a PK-ordered scan with per-row EXISTS/anti-subquery checks. While EXPLAIN for the reproduction was not captured, the STRAIGHT_JOIN and FORCE INDEX hints strongly indicate the intended plan shape, so plan similarity is estimated as sufficient.
